ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) distribution; high-intensity (white) pixels are sparse, estimated at <2% of total fluke surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity black pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-contrast white annular ring (approximate coordinate: central-lower left lobe) and a cluster of high-intensity speckles at the terminal tip of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous low-amplitude irregular serrations along both trailing edges; significant jagged pixel-amplitude increase at the distal tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe presents a smooth convex taper toward a pointed tip; right lobe presents a broader, blunt curve terminating in a highly irregular, truncated tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single high-contrast white circular ring on the left lobe; high-density cluster of white/grey pixel rosettes localized at the right lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, multi-directional diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white annular scar on left lobe; heavy biological encrustation or trauma-induced truncation at the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe tip exhibits a significantly different textural and geometric profile compared to the left lobe, appearing heavily encrusted with high-contrast material.
